stages.description: Talk to Reldo in the Varrock Castle's library.
Use the catspeak amulet (e) again to locate Bob the Cat.
Talk to the Sphinx in Sophanem.
Rake Unferth's patch
Talk to Unferth in north east Burthorpe again.
Talk to the Apothecary in south west Varrock.
Talk to Unferth whilst wearing the doctor/nurse hat, a desert shirt and a desert robe, and no weapon/shield.
Use the catspeak amulet (e) to locate Bob once more.
Talk to Unferth to complete the quest.
Talk to the Old crone just east of the Slayer Tower twice.
Give the Crone-made amulet to Malcolm.
Talk to the witch in the manor twice.
Go to the Arceuus church and dig for the Damaged soul bearer.
Return to Dondakan with the book and a gold bar.
Prepare for a fight, then return to Dondakan.
Take the Plague Sample to the Chemist in Rimmington. You can take a boat from Ardougne Dock to Rimmington for 30gp.
Return to Elena and inform her that the plague is a hoax.
Return to Sir Amik Varze in Falador Castle to complete the quest.
Attempt to enter the Woodcutting Guild on Zeah to talk to the guild's sawmill operator.
Return to the Sawmill Operator north east of Varrock.
Talk to Jack Seagull in the Port Sarim Pub.
Return to the barge.
Talk to the Odd Old Man north of the Dig Site.
Board the barge.
Return to Veos on Piscarilius docks. You can take the Lovakengj Minecart Network from Arceuus to Port Piscarilius and run south-east.
Travel to your POH or another POH with a Crafting table 3 or 4.
Speak to the sheep-penguins again in the Lumbridge sheep farm.
Tell Larry about the outpost and travel back to the iceberg.
Talk to Osman in Al Kharid.
Talk to Osman north of Sophanem.
Go back to the first floor of the castle and talk to Dr. Fenkenstrain.
Talk to Captain Rovin upstairs in the north west of Varrock Castle.
Return to the Guildmaster and ask him all the available questions.
Prepare to fight Elvarg (level 83). When you're ready, go board your boat in Port Sarim and talk to Ned.
As you did not unlock the shortcut, you will need to repair your ship again and sail to Crandor.
Talk to Oziach in his house in north western Edgeville to finish the quest.
Enter the goblin cave, east of the Fishing Guild entrance.
Talk to Nulodion at the Dwarven Black Guard camp, south of Ice Mountain.
Talk to Nulodion at the Dwarven Black Guard camp, south of Ice Mountain.
Travel to Ardougne Zoo and talk to Parroty Pete. Ask him both question 2 and 3, then use the vodka on the pineapple chunks.
Take the parrot to the Troll Stronghold prison, and hide it in the rack there.
Talk to Tegid in the south of Taverley for a dirty robe. Once you have it, return to Eadgar with all the items he needs.
Go pick a troll thistle from outside Eadgar's cave.
Get the parrot from the Troll Stronghold prison.
Enter Eagles' Peak through the Rocky Outcrop.
Bring the ferret back to Charlie in Ardougne Zoo.
Teleport to the essence mine with Aubury in south east Varrock.
Head to Port Sarim and speak to Trader Stan or any Trader Crewmember on the southern deck. To get to Port Sarim quickly, you can charter a ship.
Head to Varrock Museum and speak to Curator Haig Halen.
Talk to Zandar in the Dark Wizards' Tower west of Falador.
Get the items Mortifer tells you to get, and enter the Grotto in the south of Mort Myre.
Travel to Zanaris, ready to fight the Tanglefoot.
Travel to Zanaris.
Talk to the Gem Trader in Al Kharid.
Talk to Boot in the south western Dwarven Mines.
Enter the old ruin entrance west of Witchaven.
Go upstairs in the Jolly Boar Inn north east of Varrock and talk to Johnathon.
Enter the Edgeville Wilderness Dungeon, ready to kill Chronozon. Other players will be able to attack you.
Bring Vestri just north of Catherby the trophy.
Talk to the Rowdy Dwarf roaming the east Keldagrim pub, then give him the item he requests.
Grow the kelda seed near Rind.
Go brew the hops.
Give the Drunken Dwarf the kelda stout.
Talk to Elstan north west of Draynor Village.
Talk to King Roald in Varrock Castle, watch the cutscene, then finish the dialog with Ellamaria to finish the quest!
Use a bucket of milk on Gertrude's cat upstairs in the Lumberyard north east of Varrock.
Return to Gertrude west of Varrock to complete the quest.
Talk to the Old Crone east of the Slayer Tower.
Talk to the Old Crone and offer to help.
Enter the cave south east of the Clock Tower entrance.
Enter the cave south east of the Clock Tower entrance.
Talk to Ceril Carnillean to confirm the results of the poison.
You need to get an oily rod. Talk to Gerrant in Port Sarim to get some slime.
You need to get an oily rod. Talk to Gerrant in Port Sarim to get some slime.
You need to get an oily rod. Talk to Gerrant in Port Sarim to get some slime.
Head to Port Sarim and talk to a monk of Entrana for passage to Entrana. Bank all combat gear.
Talk to Galahad in his house west of McGrubor's Woods.
Return to Camelot and talk to King Arthur.
Go to the tower on Karamja near gold mine west of Brimhaven.
Fill the crate with 3 tinderboxes, 10 bronze axes, and either 10 raw snails or 10 raw mackerel.
Repair the bank booth.
Talk to Razvan.
Talk to Gadderanks in the shop.
Talk to Veliaf in Burgh de Rott.

Talk to Ivan in the Myreque Hideout to temple trek with him. The long route has 4 level 50 Juvinates and the short route has 2 level 75 Juvinates. You can give him a steel med helm / chainbody / platelegs, and salmon to help him survive.
Enter the trapdoor behind the Canifis pub.
Enter the Goblin Cave next to the Fishing Guild.
Talk to Radimus Erkle inside the Legends' Guild.
Bank all weapons and armour you have (including the axe), and go to Port Sarim to get a boat to Entrana.
If you've lost your Dramen branch/staff, you will need to return to Entrana and cut another. You will not need to defeat the Tree Spirit again.
Enter the Air Altar and use a dramen staff on it.
Enter the mine in the north east of Lunar Isle.
Use the waking sleep potion on the kindling
Hide in Arhein's crate behind the Candle Maker's shop in Catherby.
If you still need wax, go grab the insect repellent in a house in north Catherby. Otherwise, get your wax out.
Go up the ladder in the south east of Camelot castle.
Talk to Brother Omad again.
Talk to Brother Cedric north of the monastery.
Return to Brother Omad to finish the quest.
Talk to Daero on the 1st floor of the Tree Gnome Stronghold.
Talk to the Monkey Minder in the Ardougne Zoo whilst wielding the Karamjan monkey greegree.
Enter the trapdoor under some grass in the north west of Ape Atoll.
Return to My Arm on the roof. Be prepared to fight a baby and giant Roc.
Talk to Brian in the Port Sarim axe shop.
Talk to Aggie in Draynor Village.
Enter the H.A.M hideout west of Lumbridge and talk to Johanhus Ulsbrecht in there.
Talk to Fred the Farmer north of Lumbridge.
Talk to Seth Groats in the farm north east of Lumbridge, across the river.
Talk to Horvik in the armour shop north east of the Varrock square.
Talk to Tassie Slipcast in the Barbarian Village pottery building.
Talk to Sanfew upstairs in the Taverley herblore store.
Right-click talk to Captain Bleemadge on White Wolf Mountain.
Talk to Wizard Cromperty in north east Ardougne.
Talk to Tindel Marchant in Port Khazard.
Talk to Rantz in the Feldip Hills. AKS fairy ring or Feldip Hills Teleport.
Talk to Gnormadium Avlafrim again.
Return to Tindel Marchant in Port Khazard.
Return to Wizard Cromperty in north east Ardougne.
Return to Phantuwti in the south west house of Seers' Village.
Return to Sanfew upstairs in the Taverley herblore store.
Spin the clay into a pot lid.
Return to Horvik in the armour shop north east of the Varrock square.
Return to Seth Groats in the farm north east of Lumbridge, across the river.
Return to Brian in the Port Sarim axe shop.
Return to a Jungle Forester south of Shilo Village. CKR fairy ring or take cart from Brimhaven.
Climb up the stairs in The Blue Moon Inn in Varrock.
Dig in the middle of the cross in Falador Park, and kill the Gardener (level 4) who appears. Once killed, dig again.
Return to King Roald.
Return to the temple.
Bring Drezel 50 UNNOTED rune/pure essence in the underground of the Salve Temple to finish the quest!
Have Ned in Draynor Village make you a wig from 3 balls of wool. He can also sell you a rope for 15 coins via dialogue (or bought from his shop for 18 coins) or 4 balls of wool.
Have Ned in Draynor Village make you a wig from 3 balls of wool. He can also sell you a rope for 15 coins via dialogue (or bought from his shop for 18 coins) or 4 balls of wool.
Return to Hassan in the Al Kharid Palace to complete the quest.
Get the key from Thurgo in the shed near Mudskipper's Point.
Sail to the crate north-west of Pandemonium.
Talk to Jimmy Dazzler north of Ardougne Castle.
Talk to Hooknosed Jack in south east Varrock.  You can give Jack your vial, kwuarm, and red spiders' eggs for the rat poison
Talk to the Apothecary in west Varrock.
Talk to Jack again.
Travel to Keldagrim.
Go down the manhole near The Face.
Talk to The Face in Port Sarim again.
Use a coin on the pot next to the Snake Charmer in Pollnivneach.
Return to just outside the Port Sarim Rat Pits.
Bring the letter to Romeo in Varrock Square.
Talk to Father Lawrence in north east Varrock.
Bring the cadava berries to the Apothecary in south west Varrock.
Bring the cadava berries to the Apothecary in south west Varrock.
Talk to Romeo in Varrock Square to finish the quest.
Talk to Aubury again in south east Varrock.
Return to Thormac to finish the quest.
Use the rope on the root to enter the cave north-west of Nardah where the river turns into a waterfall.
Return to Nardah and speak to Awusah the Mayor.
Talk to the Genie again with the sole.
Return to Nardah and use the statuette on the statuette plinth in the northern house.
Talk to the Wise Old Man outside the Fishing Colony. Be prepared to fight sea trolls.
Enter the Fishing Colony, prepared to fight trolls.
Report back to Phileas Rimor in Shayzien.
Travel to Mount Quidamortem and talk to Historian Duffy.
Use a rope on the crevice west side of Quidamortem.
Return to Shiro upstairs in the War Tent located on the west side of the Shayzien Encampment.
Talk to Wizard Persten east of the Al Kharid gate.
Return to Mori in Arceuus.
Enter the Tower of Magic in Arceuus, ready to fight some level 16 Tormented Souls.
Go up the stairs in the Tower of Magic.
Go down the elevator on Mount Karuulm.
Inspect the rocks near the Arceuus Altar until you find a device.
Return to Lord Trobin Arceuus to finish the quest.
Speak to Galana in the Arceuus Library.
Enter the Crabclaw Caves.
Open the quest's journal to sync your current quest state.
Go talk to Hazelmere in his hut east of Yanille (Fairy Ring CLS).
Go back to Brimstail's cave in west Tree Gnome Stronghold.

Talk to Undor at the entrance to Wintertodt. If you've never talked to Ignisia before, you'll need to talk to her first. She is just north east of Undor. You can teleport there using a Games Necklace, or run north through Arceuus.
Enter the Forsaken Tower, west of Lovakengj.
Talk to Brundt in Rellekka's longhall to finish the quest.
Travel to Molch island via Boaty, located on the west/north/east sides of Lake Molch.
Return to General Khazard south east of Rellekka.
Talk to the scout near The Outpost, south of the Tree Gnome Stronghold.
Return to General Khazard south east of Rellekka.
Enter the cave south east of the Fishing Guild. Be prepared to fight Bouncer (level 160).
Go up to Hazelmere, on the island east of Yanille. Fairy ring CLS or minigame teleport near Yanille.
Return to King Narnode in the Grand Tree.
Return to Charlie. If entering the Stronghold through the south entrance you'll need to talk to Femi there. If you didn't help them previously you'll need to pay them 1k.
Ring the bell outside the Wizards' Guild in Yanille. Talk to Zavistic Rarve when he appears.
Travel to Brimhaven, then enter Sandy's building south of the restaurant. Search Sandy's desk for Sandy's rota.
Talk to Thurgo south of Port Sarim and give him a redberry pie.
Talk to the Squire in Falador Castle's courtyard.
Go down the ladder south of Port Sarim. Be prepared for ice giants and ice warriors to attack you.
Talk to the Cook, Hans, Father Aereck, and Bob in Lumbridge until one tells you about seeing a goblin.
Search the north west bookcase in the Varrock Castle Library.
Talk to the Goblin Generals in the Goblin Village.
Travel through the tunnels under Lumbridge until you reach Mistag.
Go up the stairs in Councillor Hughes' home in Kingstown.
Speak to Tomas Lawry in Port Piscarilius.
Sail to Red Rock, north-west of The Great Conch.
Return to Floopa at Elder Raley's house at The Great Conch.
Enter the Wizards' Tower basement, south of Draynor village.
Enter the Wizards' Tower basement, south of Draynor village.

stages.description: Return to Col. O'Niall on the pier in Witchaven.
Report back to Sir Tiffy Cashien in Falador Park.
Enter the cave north of Trollheim. There are high leveled ice trolls in here, so Protect from Melee and be careful!
Return to Ug with the trollweiss flowers.
Challenge Arrg to a fight. Please check the wiki for instructions to setup a safe spot.
Right-click the Commorb and select 'contact' to contact Savant.
Go to Canifis. Finish the conversation when Savant calls you. If you accidentally exit this conversation, move away and enter Canifis again.
Go to the centre of the Tree Gnome Village and go down the ladder at the entrance.
Return to Rat Burgiss south of Varrock.
Travel to the chaos altar with the wand and 15 chaos runes. You can either enter with a chaos talisman, or use the abyss.
Return to Surok Magis in the Varrock Library with the wand and a bowl.
Return to Rat Burgiss south of Varrock.
Dig behind Lumbridge Castle, just outside the kitchen door.
